references.text: A voice cries out in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord; make straight paths for him!

He said: Send word to all the people of the land and say: Gather together before me, and I will let you hear my words, so that you may learn to fear me all the days you live on the earth, and so that you may teach your children.
The Lord gives the word; the messengers are a great host.
